# Pine Haven Assisted Living

> Pine Haven Assisted Living is a small, family-owned senior care home in
> Hemlock, Michigan, about 25 minutes west of Saginaw. We provide assisted
> living, memory care, and respite care in warm, six-bedroom residential homes
> — with a registered nurse and LPNs on staff, home-cooked meals, and on-site
> companion animals (alpacas, a llama, sheep, goats, and chickens).

## Key facts
- Location: 515 N Brennan Rd, Hemlock, MI 48626
- Service area: Hemlock, Saginaw, Midland, Bay City, and Merrill, Michigan
- Services: assisted living; memory care (Alzheimer's, dementia, frontotemporal dementia, Lewy Body Dementia); short-term respite care
- Setting: six-bedroom residential homes, state-licensed for 18 residents (not a large institution)
- Care features: registered nurse and licensed practical nurses (LPNs) on staff, 24-hour support, medication management, three home-cooked meals daily, planned activities, on-site companion animals
- Pricing: semi-private rooms from $3,500/mo, private rooms from $3,900/mo; financial assistance available; long-term care insurance and Medicaid waiver accepted
- Hours: open 24 hours a day, 365 days a year
- Contact: (989) 642-5761 · pinehavenassistedliving@gmail.com
